patterns.note: The main content area is structured in a two-column layout, featuring a primary content flow on the left and a persistent, sticky summary/call-to-action panel on the right.
Both the primary navigation header and the right-hand call-to-action panel remain sticky at the top and right of the viewport, respectively, as the user scrolls down the page.
Primary calls to action are prominently highlighted with a vibrant green, providing a strong visual contrast against the predominantly neutral white and light grey backgrounds.
Information-dense sections, such as the FAQ, utilize an accordion pattern to present content concisely, allowing users to expand and collapse details.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header and a sticky right-hand information panel, which are fixed to the viewport using CSS positioning to maintain visibility of navigation and primary calls to action during scroll.
Content is organized into distinct, well-padded sections, using subtle background color variations (white and light grey) to visually separate them and improve readability.
Interactive content, such as frequently asked questions, is implemented with an accordion mechanism, allowing users to expand and collapse sections to reveal or hide detailed information.

design_tokens.type_scale: A balanced sans-serif type scale with clear hierarchy, using larger, bold weights for headings and readable, lighter weights for body text and details.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, input fields, and card-like elements feature slightly rounded corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (comfortable padding around sections and elements, with a consistent rhythm that avoids feeling overly dense or airy).

standout: The most distinctive feature is the persistent, sticky right-hand summary and call-to-action panel, which effectively keeps the core offer and conversion points in constant view as the user scrolls. This design choice is highly effective for a product-focused page, ensuring key information and actions are always accessible.
